seed: Shannon Byrne Susko, CULTURAL: Team Core Values Discovery, and Discovering or Confirming your Team Core Values with your Whole Leadership Team (adapted from Jim Collins’ Mission to Mars), Metronomics. Byron Darlison, Values: How Not To Chase Your Tail (darlison.com).

slides.title: No agreed Core Values? Run Mission to Mars before the next session.
slides.headline: No agreed Core Values? Run Mission to Mars before the next session.
slides.support: The leadership team runs one session, with the whole company if you can.
body: Everyone votes for the top three.
A small group drafts a name and a descriptor for each.
Bring the draft to the next session to confirm it, then share the Core Values with the whole company.
notes: Run Mission to Mars when the team has no agreed Core Values, or when its values failed the test. A team whose values passed the test skips this homework.
The values come from the whole company, not only the leadership team. Then the language belongs to everyone.
The CEO and every leader take part in the session.
Homework: run the session, draft the names and descriptors, and bring the draft to the next session. Confirm it there, then share the Core Values with the whole company.
